**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The document contains no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening The Deerskin Companies:

- **Fees (§ 3.1–3.4):** a fixed 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, with payment, reconciliation and audit mechanics only — no undertaking to extend HDI our best terms and no obligation to match third-party offers.
- **§ 1.8:** the sole "no less favorably" covenant runs *against* HDI (it must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favourably than its own catalog titles) — a benefit to us, so not flagged per the direction guidance.
- **§ 7.1:** cross-promotion is expressly mutual, "on a reciprocal and equitable basis," and each party controls and approves its own materials; this is not an MFN in HDI's favour.
- **§ 6.1:** restricts the Company from similar competing Internet projects and grants HDI exclusivity in the "Deerskin" brand online. This is an exclusivity covenant, not a pricing/terms MFN; it belongs to the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here.

No redline proposed.
